rows=np.arange(len(z)); groups=len(nodes)//4
for label,folds in [('shift',np.split(rows,len(fields))),('rosette',[rows[(rows//4)%groups==i] for i in range(groups)])]:
 errors=[]
 for test in folds:

 print(label,'worst held-out RMS',max(errors))
